assertions.summary: The frontend did not establish runtime connectivity. The page title loaded as eta-mu, but the UI showed a red `Disconnected` status and captured network traffic targeted `http://127.0.0.1:9787` for simulation and agent APIs instead of a healthy connected backend.

evidence.observation: Header shows `eta-mu world daemon` with a red `Disconnected` status indicator.

Reload captured repeated fetches to `http://127.0.0.1:9787/api/simulation?...` and `http://127.0.0.1:9787/api/agent/threat-radar/report?...` with no successful websocket or runtime connection evidence.

assertions.summary: Catalog/runtime data did not render successfully in the frontend. The page text reported `no field particles in current stream`, and network capture showed requests to `http://127.0.0.1:9787/api/catalog` and `.../api/catalog/stream` without corresponding visible catalog data.

evidence.observation: The rendered text includes `● no field particles in current stream` instead of loaded catalog content.
Reload captured GET requests to `http://127.0.0.1:9787/api/catalog?perspective=hybrid` and `http://127.0.0.1:9787/api/catalog/stream?...`.

assertions.summary: Visible UI still contains narrative residue. The page body and screenshot show labels such as `witness thread`, `VIEW LENS KEEPER`, `ANCHOR REGISTRY`, and `FORK TAX CANTICLE`.

evidence.observation: The operating rail and pane labels visibly include `WITNESS THREAD`, `VIEW LENS KEEPER`, `ANCHOR REGISTRY`, and `FORK TAX CANTICLE`.
Boolean checks for `witnessThreadVisible`, `viewLensKeeperVisible`, `anchorRegistryVisible`, and `forkTaxCanticleVisible` are all true.

assertions.summary: The browser title no longer says Fork Tales. The page title is `eta-mu` and the main header reads `eta-mu world daemon`.

evidence.observation: The header shows `eta-mu world daemon` and does not contain Fork Tales branding.

frictions.description: A dedicated browser-validator subagent could not proceed due to permission restrictions, so the parent validator collected the browser evidence directly with the required agent-browser session.
frictions.resolution: Used agent-browser session 9a752a0a5ae8 to gather screenshots, page text, and network evidence.

notes: The frontend dev server was already available on port 5173; the validator reused it instead of starting another instance.
Direct curl checks outside the browser also showed `http://127.0.0.1:8787/` and `/api/catalog` returning HTTP 404 while `http://127.0.0.1:9787` was unreachable.
